cells: Former CJI / Supreme Court Judge / Eminent person

blocks.content: The Lokpal is a multi-member body, consisting of a chairperson and a maximum of eight members.

rows: Former CJI, former Supreme Court Judge, or Eminent Person with 25+ years expertise
Former Supreme Court Judge or former Chief Justice of a High Court
Eminent person with 25+ years expertise in anti-corruption, public administration, or finance
Belonging to SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, and Women

items: Crucial percentage rules: Exactly 50% of members must be Judicial Members, and at least 50% must be reserved for SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women.
Selection Committee Composition: Prime Minister (Chairperson), Speaker of Lok Sabha, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, CJI (or nominee), and an Eminent Jurist.
Tenure limit is 5 years or up to 70 years of age, whichever is earlier.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Lokpal is a multi-member body consisting of a Chairperson and a maximum of 8 members.
50% of the members must be Judicial Members (former Supreme Court Judge or former High Court Chief Justice).
A minimum of 50% of the members must be from SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, and Women.
The Chairperson and members hold office for a term of 5 years or until attaining the age of 70 years.
Appointments are made by the President on the recommendation of a Selection Committee headed by the Prime Minister.
